senses.gloss: छनच्छन् छनच्छन्, i. e. repeated छनत् before इति, A word imitative of the sound of falling drops, Amar. 89.

छन्द् छन्द्, i. 1 and 10, Par. (ved. also छदय, Par., Ātm.).
 --i. 1.
 1. To appear (ved.).
 2. To please.
 --i. 10, or rather Caus.
 1. To wait on, Rām. 2, 97, 1; Chr. 48, 8.
 2. To present (especially with वरेण), Rām. 6, 4, 43.
 --With the prep. अव अव, i. 1, To desire, MBh. 12, 7378.
 --With उप उप, Caus.
 1. To wait on, Ragh. 5, 58.
 2. To seduce, Prab. 101, 10.
 --With सम् सम्, To wait on, to present, MBh. 3, 13507.
 --Cf. Lat. spons, spontis for spond + ti, spondeo; σπένδειν.

छन्द छन्द् + अ,
 I. adj. Flattering, Chr. 294, 6 = Rigv. i. 92, 6.
 II. m.
 1. Appearance, Hariv. 8359.
 2. Wish, Rām. 2, 9, 7.
 3. Will, Yājñ. 2, 195.
 4. Self-help, Man. 8, 176.
 5. Power, MBh. 12, 1820.
 --Comp.
छन्दतस् छन्द + तस्, adv. By one's own will, Yājñ. 3, 203.

छन्दस् छन्द् + अस्, n.
 1. Pleasure, MBh. 12, 7376.
 2. A holy hymn, MBh. 5, 1224.
 3. The Vedas, MBh. 12, 12933.
 4. Poetical metre, Bhag. 10, 35.
 5. Metrics, Pañc. ii. d. 34.
 --Comp.
छन्दस्कृत छन्दस्-कृत (vb. कृ), n. The metrical part of the Vedas, Man. 4, 100.
छन्दोग छन्दोग, i. e. छन्दस्-ग (vb. गै), m. A chanter of the Sāma-Veda, Man. 3, 145.
छन्दोमय छन्दोमय, i. e. छन्दस् + मय, adj., f. यी, Having the Vedas as one's substance, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 11.

छान्दस छान्दस, i. e. छन्दस् + अ, adj.
 1. Referring, or referable, to the Vedas (vedic), Hariv. 12284.
 2. Conversant with the Vedas, Kathās. 18, 108.
छान्दोग्य छान्दोग्य i. e. छन्दोग + य, n. The name of a Brāhmaṇa and Upaniṣad, belonging to the vedic literature, Vedāntas. in Chr. 216, 5.
छन्दोवृत्त छन्दोव्˚, i. e. छन्दस्-, n. metre, MBh. 1, 28.
